title: John Mack and Terence McKenna on the Western paradigm bursting open

tellings.quote: John Max says oh it's gonna it's G to burst open and we're all going to realize that the Western Paradigm is incredibly myopic and closed

plain: A man named John Mack is said to have predicted that the Western way of seeing the world would "burst open", and that people would come to see it as "incredibly myopic and closed". Michels tells this himself without naming a source. He sets it beside the thinker Terence McKenna and the historian of science Thomas Kuhn, who wrote about how big scientific worldviews collapse and get replaced. If they are right, our whole picture of reality is about to change.
